items.title: Rescue efforts intensified to reach people trapped in Trishuli 3 ‘A’ tunnel
items.summary: KATHMANDU: The government has continued efforts for the past 2 days to rescue people trapped inside the tunnel of the Trishuli 3 ‘A’ Hydropower Project in Rasuwa, with work to clear the tunnel entrance intensified since Saturday morning. Following reports that people were trapped inside the tunnel, the government prioritized deploying rescue teams to clear sludge and debris while advancing efforts to open the tunnel entrance. A joint team of 82 personnel, including 62 from the Army and 20 from the Armed Police Force Nepal and Nepal Police, has been continuously deployed since last night to clear the tunnel entrance and expedite search…

items.title: Update: 626 bodies recovered from Bhote Koshi flood disaster
items.summary: KATHMANDU: The National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA) has reported that the bodies of 626 people, including various human body parts, have been recovered following the Bhote Koshi flood in Rasuwa as of 10:00 AM Saturday. According to the latest data, 2,426 people remain out of contact. Of them, 933 are workers from hydropower projects. Among security personnel, 45 from the Army, 27 from the Nepal Police, and 13 from the Armed Police Force (APF) are missing. The highest number of recovered bodies, 233, was reported in Chitwan, followed by 158 in Purba Nawalparasi, 47 in Paschim Nawalparasi, 51 in Nuwakot, 48 in…

items.title: Novas tempestades devem atingir o Rio Grande do Sul até segunda-feira
items.summary: Esta sexta-feira (28) foi marcada por fortes chuvas em cidades de várias regiões do Rio Grande do Sul. Em Porto Alegre, um menino de oito anos morreu e uma pessoa ficou ferida após uma árvore atingir uma residência. A expectativa é de que novas tempestades atinjam a região até a próxima segunda-feira, com risco de inundações nos rios Jacuí, Taquari, Caí e Uruguai. São esperados ventos fortes e formação de granizo, atingindo as regiões Central, Oeste, Cales, Serra e Nordeste.
